movement: Touch fingertips to the side of the forehead, then move outward
Touch the fingertips to the chin or lips, then move the hand forward and down toward the person
Rub the palm in a circle on the chest
tip: Warming your heart to ask nicely

movement: Rub the fist in a circle on the chest
tip: A fist circling a heavy heart

movement: Wave by bending the fingers down and up at the knuckles a few times
Bend the wrist so the fist nods up and down
tip: Your fist is a head nodding yes

movement: Snap the index and middle fingers down onto the thumb
Tap the middle finger of one H-hand twice across the index finger of the other, forming an X
tip: Two fingers cross like signing your name

handshape: A-hand (thumb up) on a flat palm
movement: Rest the thumbs-up fist on the other flat palm and lift both hands up together
tip: One hand gives the other a lift

movement: Tap the fingertips of both hands together a few times
tip: Adding more and more to the pile

movement: Tap the thumb on the chin twice
tip: Female family signs sit at the chin

movement: Tap the thumb on the forehead twice
tip: Male family signs sit at the forehead

handshape: F-hand (thumb and index touching) on both hands
movement: Start with both F-hands together, then circle them outward until the little fingers meet
tip: Your hands draw a circle around everyone

movement: Hook the index fingers together, then flip and hook them the other way

handshape: Flat hands, one arm resting on the other
movement: Cradle one forearm on the other and rock them side to side
Brush the hand up the chest in small forward circles, with a smile. Often done with both hands
tip: Joy bubbling up from your heart

handshape: 5-hand on both hands, palms facing you
movement: Hold both open hands in front of the face, then draw them slowly down
Rest the bent fingertips on the chest, then rotate the hands downward as the shoulders slump
Cross both fists over the heart and hug them to the chest
Brush the middle fingers up the chest in alternating circles
Hold up the index finger, palm facing you
tip: Just like counting on your fingers

movement: Hold up the index and middle fingers, palm facing you
Hold up the thumb, index and middle fingers, palm facing you
tip: ASL three starts with the thumb

movement: Hold up four fingers with the thumb folded in, palm facing you
Hold up the open hand with all fingers spread, palm facing you
Touch the thumb to the little finger, other fingers up, palm out
Touch the thumb to the ring finger, other fingers up, palm out
Touch the thumb to the middle finger, other fingers up, palm out
Touch the thumb to the index finger, other fingers up, palm out
Hold a thumbs-up and give it a small twist or shake
Rest the thumb on the chin and bend the index finger a couple of times, eyebrows down
Hold both open hands palms up and shake them slightly side to side, eyebrows down
Hold the index finger up, palm out, and shake it side to side, eyebrows down
Touch the fingertips to the forehead, then pull the hand forward and down into a Y-hand
tip: Pulling a question out of your mind

handshape: Bent hands, backs of fingers together
movement: Start with the knuckles of both bent hands together, then roll them forward so the palms face up
Tap the fingertips to the mouth a couple of times
Bring a C-hand to the mouth and tip it up as if drinking from a cup
Tap the index finger of a W-hand on the chin twice
tip: W for water at your lips

movement: Squeeze an open C-hand closed into a fist a couple of times
Move the C-hand down the middle of the chest
tip: Food travelling down to an empty stomach

movement: Brush the index finger down across the lips and chin a couple of times
Hold up a B-hand and twist it back and forth at the wrist
Hold a G-hand and twist it back and forth at the wrist
Hold a Y-hand and twist it back and forth at the wrist
Draw the side of the index finger across the forehead
Place the open hand on the chest, then pull it away while closing the fingertips together
tip: Pulling a white shirt away from your chest
